from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdDistGeom, AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
import numpy as np, math, sys
smi='C(C)(C)(C)c1ccc2c(c(n3c7n(CCc5cccc(C6%10OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F)n95)cc3)1)n([Fe]789%10)c1c(n4c8n6cc4)c(C(C)(C)C)ccc12'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi, sanitize=False)
m.UpdatePropertyCache(strict=False)
mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
# set a name
mh.SetProp('_Name','mol_0055')
# Embed with explicit Hs. Try multiple seeds if fail.
best=None
for seed in [1,2,3,4,5,42,100,2024]:
    params=rdDistGeom.ETKDGv3()
    params.randomSeed=seed
